note: Finished events the model learns from. Drop a Luma guest export in this folder, name it starting with the event date (2026-08-12-princeton.csv), and add a line below. On GitHub Pages this folder is also read directly from the repo, so the manifest is only a fallback. Optional per-event keys: label, date, tz, region, venue, lat, lon, startHour, venueSource.
venueNote: lat and lon are the event venue map pin used for the distance predictor. Venue names, full addresses and coordinates were verified against each event's Luma page and linked map on 2026-10-19; venueSource records that page. An event with no coordinates still trains group booking and lead time and contributes nothing to the distance term.
